evidence: The frozen instruction.md:1-5 has three coherent paragraphs and points to six notes; exactly six note files exist under task/environment/instructions. I read each note for real spelling errors, stray author text, duplicate paragraphs, paths from another machine and contradictions. The paths in instruction.md:3,5 and integration.md:3,7,9 are intended runtime paths (/instructions, /assets/seed_data.json, /app, /api/health, /app/app.db and DB_PATH), consistent with the local app at / in instruction.md:5 and integration.md:3. No TODO, FIXME, XXX, CHANGE_ME, placeholder, drive-letter path, /Users/ path or /home/ path occurs in the task instruction or six notes (targeted rg returned no matches). The template's instruction.md and notes.md contain CHANGE_ME, but the frozen task replaced both; that template text is not delivered to the builder. The brief's no-sign-in wording agrees with overview.md:3, policy.md:3 and tests/app_context.md:1-3. Domain terms such as CodeMirror, TipTap and WebAssembly and British spellings such as Colour are intentional, not spelling errors. A plausible broken app could satisfy this editorial row while failing product behavior; that belongs to other checks. A conforming app should not fail this row over these valid proper nouns or spelling variants. No runtime run is needed to establish the source-text observation; the absent raw-evidence-index is not treated as runtime proof.
